# manifold

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:frameKindManifold`](gmeow-frameKindManifold.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/frameKindManifold>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A topological space that locally resembles Euclidean space. Coordinate charts and tangent spaces are solver-layer constructs ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), not asserted as OWL axioms.
